title: Conditional Decisions (2 Stages)
description:
Practice writing if statements across 2 stages:
1. Create variable age = 20. If age >= 18, print "Eligible to vote".
2. Create variable temperature = 35. If temperature > 30, print "Hot day".
starter_code:
# Stage 1: Check age eligibility (>= 18) and print "Eligible to vote"
age = 20


# Stage 2: Check temperature (> 30) and print "Hot day"
temperature = 35
